bingo.line: I'm headed to the church to play Bingo
stanza: Little Indian kids on a bridge up in Canada
They can balance and they can climb
Like their fathers before them
They'll walk the girders of the Manhattan skyline
Shine your light on me, Miss Liberty
Because as soon as this ferry boat docks
I'm headed to the church to play Bingo
Fleece me with the gamblers' flocks

bingo.line: It couldn't just be "John Doe" or "Bingo"
bingo.linePrev: My last name, a thousand vowels fading down a sinkhole to a susurrus
bingo.lineNext: My address, a made-up language written out in living glyphs

flamingo.line: Well, the maximum lawman run down Flamingo
stanza: Well, the maximum lawman run down Flamingo
Chasing the Rat and the barefoot girl
And the kids 'round here look just like shadows
Always quiet, holding hands
From the churches to the jails
Tonight, all is silence in the world
As we take our stand
Down in Jungleland
Bucka-bucka-bucka-bucka-bucka-bucka, haha!
You know the deal, it's just me, yo
Beats by Su-Preemo for all of my people, Negroes and Latinos
And even the gringos
